description: A yellow mancala-style board with green, blue, and clear glass marbles sits on a red bedspread in front of a white pillow. The right hand hovers over the right half of the board, then reaches left to pinch up a marble from a pocket, drags it along the row, and releases marbles one by one into successive circular wells toward the right side, with the board as the right-hand object while the left hand stays out of view.
